newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jobless rate edges lower in February.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jobless rate edges lower in February.

text.p: The U.S. unemployment rate edged lower last month to 5.3 percent as the economy created more jobs than it has since last spring, the government said on Friday, in the government's first reading of the nation's economic health in February.
The Labor Department reported that a whopping 339,000 non-farm jobs were created, the most since May, after payrolls rose by a revised 247,000 in January.
